Start where surgeons already are.

Stella stays STAAR's official calculator, the ordering environment and the single system of record. The recommendation is born there, and the order is confirmed there.

Sign in to Stella
stella.staar.com · Dashboard

Official recommendation

Generated in Stella before anything else participates, so it can never be confused with an outside calculation.

Controlled launch to EVO Connect

One toggle inside Stella carries a pseudonymous case ID, the agreed data set and the recommendation. One direction only.

Confirmed order

The surgeon confirms in Stella. If the chosen lens differs, Stella asks for an explicit confirmation — and the final order flows back into the record.

EVO Connect · Clinic platform

Sizing solved. The rest, connected.

The hardest call in an ICL is the size. EVO Connect puts the methods you trust next to Stella's recommendation, keeps what you chose and why, and carries the case through planning, surgery and follow-up — with your own data building up behind it.

Open EVO Connect
evo-connect · Dashboard

The sizing call, settled

ICL Guru, ICLFIT and CASIA2 next to the Stella recommendation, each labelled with modality, device and formula version. You choose, and the reason stays with the case.

Your data, your evidence

Every case you do feeds your own record: vault outcomes, size mix, refractive results. Your patients, your numbers — ready to make the next case better.

Cases discussed with peers

A surgeon community inside the platform. Share an anonymised case, ask about a difficult vault, and see how others handled the same anatomy.

Every lens order, live

Reserved, manufactured, in transit, delivered. Follow the state of each lens in real time, without leaving the case.
